grammarTopic: Tổng ôn + làm lại câu đã sai
speakingTopic: Giới thiệu + bộ ý dùng chung

plan.content: Tab Tổng ôn: dấu hiệu thì, where/which, 20 mẫu viết lại, 6 bước soát lỗi
Tab Luyện thêm: các câu bạn từng sai từ ngày 1 + câu viết lại
12 câu theo mẫu trong tài liệu trường (tab Luyện thêm, cuối trang)
Nói to bài giới thiệu 3 lần + 1 chủ đề ngẫu nhiên với Claude
10 câu, rồi nghỉ sớm, ngủ đủ

sections.title: Thì: 1 câu hỏi chốt
rows: yesterday, ago, last…, in 2019, when I was young
so far, since, for, yet, already, ever, … times
by + mốc quá khứ, before/when + V2 (việc xảy ra trước)
have BEEN + V3 (đó là bị động)

sections.title: Where hay which: nhìn PHÍA SAU chỗ trống
rows: Da Lat, which is famous for flowers
S + V còn thiếu tân ngữ
the hotel which we booked · the country which I love
the hotel where we stayed · the café where I meet friends

sections.title: 20 mẫu viết lại câu (tài liệu trường)
rows: Although + S + V ⇔ Despite / In spite of + N / V-ing
not as … as ⇔ -er than (đổi chủ ngữ) · No one … -er than ⇔ the -est
so + adj + that ⇔ such + a + adj + N + that ⇔ (not) adj enough to V
It is hard to learn ⇔ Learning … is hard
started … ago ⇔ have V3 for · last V2 in ⇔ haven't V3 since
should V ⇔ had better V · If I were you, I'd V ⇔ I advise you to V
too + adj + to V ⇔ not + adj trái nghĩa + enough to V
Hiện tại → If + V2, would V · Quá khứ → If + had V3, would have V3
Hiện tại → wish + V2 · Quá khứ → wish + had V3
be + V3 theo đúng thì; vật làm chủ ngữ
have + vật + V3 · have + người + V · get + người + to V
because + mệnh đề ⇔ because of / due to + N
It takes sb + time + to V ⇔ sb spends + time + V-ing
haven't V3 for + time ⇔ It is + time + since + S + last V2
The + -er + S + V, the + -er + S + V
Why don't you V? ⇔ suggested that + S + (should) V
Let's V ⇔ Why don't we V?
asked if / wh- + S + V (không đảo, lùi thì) · told sb (not) to V

notes: Viết lại câu: chép lại phần KHÔNG đổi (tên, đồ vật, thời gian), chỉ thay phần cấu trúc. Đọc lại câu xem có thừa từ (ago, last, been) không.
Tìm lỗi sai: thì → loại từ → liên từ → số ít/nhiều → mạo từ → đại từ quan hệ.
Ngày thi: đến sớm, đi vệ sinh trước giờ thi. Paper 1 làm 4 bài đọc trước khi quá mệt, câu từ vựng nhanh.

traps.title: have/has khi có mốc quá khứ (bạn sai nhiều nhất)
traps.wrong: He has gone to work by motorbike every day last year.
traps.right: He went to work by motorbike every day last year.
traps.why: last year là mốc đã qua → quá khứ đơn.

traps.title: Thêm been vào câu chủ động
traps.wrong: I have been learned English for five years.
traps.right: I have learned English for five years.
traps.why: have been + V3 = bị động. Người tự học → have + V3.

traps.title: Viết lại câu điều kiện thiếu would / had
traps.wrong: If she taken the medicine, she had getten better.
traps.right: If she had taken the medicine, she would have got better.
traps.why: Vế if: had + V3. Vế chính: would have + V3.

extra.title: Làm lại câu đã sai + 20 mẫu viết lại
extra.note: Phần đầu là đúng những câu bạn đã sai từ ngày 1 tới giờ (lấy từ Sổ lỗi sai). Giải thích có ghi lần trước bạn chọn gì. Phần cuối là 12 câu viết lại theo 20 mẫu của tài liệu trường.

items.q: If I ___ you, I would accept the job offer.
items.explain: Vế chính có would + V → loại 2 → If I were (dùng were cho mọi ngôi). (Lần trước bạn chọn: D. had been.)

items.q: This is the first time I ___ sushi.
items.explain: This is the first/second time + S + have/has + V3. (Lần trước bạn chọn: B. eat.)

items.q: The train to Hue ___ at 7:30 tomorrow morning, according to the timetable.
items.explain: Lịch trình cố định (timetable) → hiện tại đơn dù nói về tương lai. Chủ ngữ số ít → leaves. (Lần trước bạn chọn: C. will be left.)

items.q: By the end of last year, he ___ enough money to buy a motorbike.
items.explain: By + mốc quá khứ (by the end of last year) → quá khứ hoàn thành. (Lần trước bạn chọn: B. has saved.)

items.q: He ___ to work by motorbike every day last year.
items.explain: last year → quá khứ đơn, dù là thói quen (every day). (Lần trước bạn chọn: A. has gone.)

items.q: When I got home, I realised I ___ my phone at the office.
items.explain: Mốc: lúc về nhà (quá khứ). Để quên điện thoại xảy ra trước đó → had left. (Lần trước bạn chọn: A. have left.)

items.q: By the time you come back, I ___ the report.
items.explain: By the time + hiện tại đơn (nói về tương lai) → will have + V3: sẽ xong trước lúc đó. (Lần trước bạn chọn: D. have finished.)

items.q: When I was a child, I ___ in the river every summer.
items.explain: Thói quen trong quá khứ (every summer, when I was a child) → quá khứ đơn (hoặc used to + V). (Lần trước bạn chọn: D. had swum.)

items.q: Hanoi, ___ is the capital of Vietnam, has many old buildings.
items.explain: Có dấu phẩy → không dùng that. Sau là động từ (is) → which. where cần S + V phía sau. (Lần trước bạn chọn: D. where.)

items.q: Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius.
items.explain: Sự thật hiển nhiên → hiện tại đơn: boils. (Lần trước bạn chọn: D. has boiled.)

items.q: Da Lat, ___ is famous for its flowers, attracts many tourists.
items.explain: Ngay sau là động từ (is) → which làm chủ ngữ. where cần S + V phía sau. Có dấu phẩy → không dùng that. (Lần trước bạn chọn: B. where.)

items.q: This is the house ___ my grandparents used to live.
items.explain: Sau chỗ trống: my grandparents used to live, đã đủ S + V, không thiếu tân ngữ → where (= in which). (Lần trước bạn chọn: A. which.)

items.q: I ___ in Ho Chi Minh City for five years before I moved to Hanoi.
items.explain: Việc kéo dài và kết thúc trước một việc quá khứ khác (moved) → had + V3. (Lần trước bạn chọn: A. have lived.)

items.q: I ___ to London twice, but I have never been to Paris.
items.explain: Số lần trải nghiệm tính đến nay (twice) → have been. Giống lỗi "three times so far" ngày 1. (Lần trước bạn chọn: A. went.)

items.q: My grandfather ___ in the army when he was young.
items.explain: Việc đã xong trong một giai đoạn quá khứ (when he was young) → quá khứ đơn. (Lần trước bạn chọn: A. has served.)

items.q: Listen! Someone ___ at the door.
items.explain: "Listen!" → việc đang xảy ra ngay lúc nói → am/is/are + V-ing. (Lần trước bạn chọn: C. has knocked.)

items.q: This is the café ___ I often meet my friends.
items.explain: I often meet my friends đã đủ S + V + tân ngữ → where (= at which). (Lần trước bạn chọn: A. which.)

items.q: She ___ in Da Nang when she was a student.
items.explain: when she was a student → giai đoạn đã qua → quá khứ đơn. (Lần trước bạn chọn: B. has lived.)

items.q: After she ___ her homework, she went to bed.
items.explain: Việc xảy ra trước một việc khác trong quá khứ → had + V3. (Lần trước bạn chọn: C. has finished.)

items.q: Mai ___ her leg when she was skiing last winter.
items.explain: Việc ngắn xen vào (broke) khi việc khác đang diễn ra (was skiing) → quá khứ đơn. (Lần trước bạn chọn: B. has broken.)

items.q: You can borrow my laptop ___ you promise to take care of it.
items.explain: as long as = miễn là (điều kiện). unless = nếu không, sai nghĩa. (Lần trước bạn chọn: B. unless.)

items.q: A new hospital ___ in our town at the moment.
items.explain: 'at the moment' → tiếp diễn; bệnh viện được xây → bị động tiếp diễn: is being built. (Lần trước bạn chọn: D. was built.)

items.q: I ___ to Da Lat three times so far.
items.explain: 'three times', 'so far' → hiện tại hoàn thành: have been. (Lần trước bạn chọn: B. went.)

items.q: We ___ three units of the book so far.
items.explain: so far → have + V3. Người tự làm → không có been. (Lần trước bạn chọn: D. have been finished.)

items.q: Look at those dark clouds! It ___ rain.
items.explain: Có dấu hiệu rõ ràng trước mắt (dark clouds) → be going to. (Lần trước bạn chọn: B. will.)

items.q: What ___ at 8 p.m. last night? I called you but you didn't answer.
items.explain: Một giờ cụ thể trong quá khứ (8 p.m. last night) → hỏi việc đang làm lúc đó → was/were + V-ing. (Lần trước bạn chọn: A. did you do.)

sets.title: Đọc bấm giờ · Tom Cruise (Test 2 · 30–35)
sets.directions: Read the passage and choose the best answer. Giới hạn 10 phút.
passage: Over the years, Tom Cruise has become one of the most popular and successful actors in the world. Tom is now an international star, who gets paid millions of dollars for every film he makes. 'I'm lucky,' says Tom. 'I'm doing what I love, and I'm having a great time. Lots of people would love to do this job, but they didn't get the lucky breaks or chances that I did.' For many of us, however, Tom was more than just lucky or good-looking, as acting ability and great determination were needed for him to become one of Hollywood's biggest names.

Is Tom happy with his success so far? He has a different outlook on his career than you might expect. 'I've always looked to the future,' says Tom. 'I feel I'm always developing as an actor. I'm looking for new things all the time. I want to challenge myself to be better and always try new things. I know I've made a lot of progress in my career, but I still have ambitions for the future.'

After interviewing him, I understood that the real Tom Cruise is a man with a very interesting and agreeable personality. He has a mind of his own and he's not like the characters in his movies, even though they may reflect Tom's personal style in the way he plays them.
The amazing success of Tom's career has been due to his talent as an actor and his personal strength and single-mindedness. Tom knew what he wanted to do with his life and gave his best to succeed.

items.q: The purpose of this text is to ___.
options: discuss Tom Cruise's success in acting
discuss Tom Cruise's outlook on life
tell the readers how Tom Cruise's strong personality is an important part of his success
argue that Tom Cruise's success is mostly good luck
items.explain: Đoạn cuối chốt: thành công nhờ tài năng + sức mạnh cá nhân, ý chí. A quá chung; D ngược ý người viết.
items.evidence: The amazing success of Tom's career has been due to his talent as an actor and his personal strength and single-mindedness

items.q: Which of the following does NOT describe Tom Cruise?
items.explain: ambitions (A), agreeable personality (B), determination (C) đều có. Anh ấy luôn thử cái mới → không bảo thủ (conservative).
items.evidence: I want to challenge myself to be better and always try new things

items.q: How does Tom compare himself to other people who try to become actors?
options: He works harder than they do.
He was more fortunate at certain points in his career.
He had more qualities than they do to be a successful actor.
He looks to the future more than they do.
items.explain: they didn't get the lucky breaks or chances that I did → anh ấy may mắn hơn. C là ý của người viết, không phải lời Tom.
items.evidence: they didn't get the lucky breaks or chances that I did

items.q: How does Tom describe his attitude to his work?
options: He is now very satisfied with what he has achieved.
He looks forward and wants to improve and develop.
He has to face too many challenges.
He is the characters in his movies.
items.explain: I've always looked to the future … always developing … challenge myself to be better.
items.evidence: I've always looked to the future

items.q: The writer says that Tom Cruise ___.
options: has a personality similar to the characters he plays
has no personal style when acting
is very likeable as a person
items.explain: agreeable personality = tính cách dễ mến → likeable. B ngược (he's not like the characters).
items.evidence: a man with a very interesting and agreeable personality

items.q: A synonym of 'single-mindedness' is ___.
items.explain: single-mindedness = chuyên tâm theo đuổi một mục tiêu = determination. Câu sau giải thích: knew what he wanted … gave his best.
items.evidence: Tom knew what he wanted to do with his life and gave his best to succeed

transform.source: She didn't take the medicine, so she didn't get better.
answers: If she had taken the medicine, she would have got better.
If she had taken the medicine, she would have gotten better.
transform.explain: Thực tế quá khứ → loại 3: had + V3, would have + V3, đổi cả 2 vế sang khẳng định. (Lần trước bạn viết: If she taken the medicine, she had getten better.)

transform.source: It takes me 30 minutes to get to work.
answers: I spend 30 minutes getting to work.
I spend thirty minutes getting to work.
transform.explain: It takes sb + time + to V ⇔ S + spend + time + V-ing. Hiện tại → spend (không phải spent). (Lần trước bạn viết: I spend 30 minutes to get to work.)

transform.source: I started working here two years ago.
answers: I have worked here for two years.
I have been working here for two years.
transform.explain: started … ago → have + V3 … for + khoảng thời gian. (Lần trước bạn viết: I have been started working here two years ago..)

transform.source: They will build a new school next year.
answers: A new school will be built next year.
transform.explain: Tương lai đơn bị động: will be + V3. Bỏ 'by them'. (Lần trước bạn viết: A new school will be built a new school next year..)

transform.source: People say that he is very rich.
answers: It is said that he is very rich.
transform.explain: People say that … → It is said that … (bị động với động từ tường thuật). (Lần trước bạn viết: It is said he was very rich.)

transform.source: The last time I saw her was in 2020.
answers: I haven't seen her since 2020.
transform.explain: The last time + S + V2 + was + mốc → S + haven't + V3 + since + mốc. (Lần trước bạn viết: I haven't been seen her was since 2020.)

transform.source: It's two months since he last called me.
answers: He hasn't called me for two months.
He hasn't called me for two months now.
transform.explain: It's + khoảng thời gian + since + S + last + V2 → S + hasn't + V3 + for + khoảng thời gian. (Lần trước bạn viết: He hasn't been last called me for two months.)

transform.source: I started learning English five years ago.
answers: I have learned English for five years.
I have learnt English for five years.
I have been learning English for five years.
transform.explain: started … ago → have + V3 (hoặc have been + V-ing) + for + khoảng thời gian. Bỏ "ago". (Lần trước bạn viết: I have been learned English for five years.)

transform.source: My brother started working in Hanoi two years ago.
answers: My brother has worked in Hanoi for two years.
My brother has been working in Hanoi for two years.
transform.explain: started … ago → has + V3 (hoặc has been + V-ing) + for. Không viết has been worked. (Lần trước bạn viết: My brother has started working for two years in Hanoi.)

transform.source: I don't have a car, so I can't drive to work.
answers: If I had a car, I could drive to work.
If I had a car, I would be able to drive to work.
If I had a car, I would drive to work.
transform.explain: Thực tế hiện tại → loại 2: don't have → had; can't → could (đổi phủ định thành khẳng định). (Lần trước bạn viết: If I had a car, I drove to work.)

transform.source: She last saw him when she was ten.
answers: She hasn't seen him since she was ten.
transform.explain: last + V2 → hasn't + V3 + since. Không có been.

transform.source: They haven't written emails for two months.
answers: They last wrote emails two months ago.
They last wrote an email two months ago.
They last wrote email two months ago.
transform.explain: haven't V3 for … → last + V2 + … ago.

transform.source: My brother didn't buy that car because he didn't have enough money.
answers: If my brother had had enough money, he would have bought that car.
transform.explain: Quá khứ → loại 3: had had (đúng, 2 chữ had) … would have bought.

transform.source: People don't understand him because he doesn't speak clearly.
answers: If he spoke clearly, people would understand him.
transform.explain: Hiện tại → loại 2: spoke … would understand.

transform.source: I didn't know that she was ill.
answers: I wish I had known that she was ill.
I wish I had known she was ill.
transform.explain: Tiếc về quá khứ → wish + had V3.

transform.source: They have cancelled the meeting.
answers: The meeting has been cancelled.
The meeting has been cancelled by them.
transform.explain: Hiện tại hoàn thành bị động: has been + V3 (vật → có been).

transform.source: An engineer repaired my computer a week ago.
answers: I got an engineer to repair my computer a week ago.
transform.explain: get + người + to V (nhờ ai làm). have + người + V; have + vật + V3.

transform.source: It took them 5 months to build the house.
answers: They spent 5 months building the house.
They spent five months building the house.
transform.explain: It took + sb + time + to V → sb + spent + time + V-ing.

transform.source: Nam hasn't been to Ha Noi for 2 years.
answers: It is 2 years since Nam last went to Ha Noi.
It is two years since Nam last went to Ha Noi.
It is 2 years since Nam was last in Ha Noi.
It is 2 years since Nam went to Ha Noi.
It is two years since Nam went to Ha Noi.
transform.explain: haven't V3 for + time → It is + time + since + S + (last) + V2.

transform.source: As he grows older, he becomes increasingly cheerful.
answers: The older he grows, the more cheerful he becomes.
The older he gets, the more cheerful he becomes.
transform.explain: The + so sánh hơn + S + V, the + so sánh hơn + S + V.

transform.source: The question was so difficult that no one could answer it.
answers: It was such a difficult question that no one could answer it.
transform.explain: so + adj ⇔ such + a + adj + N.

transform.source: The car crashed because the driver was careless.
answers: Because of the driver's carelessness, the car crashed.
Because of the careless driver, the car crashed.
transform.explain: because + mệnh đề → because of + cụm danh từ (carelessness / the careless driver).

speaking.introTitle: Bài giới thiệu cuối cùng: 4–5 câu
intro: Good morning. My name is ___ and I'm from ___.
I graduated from ___ University, majoring in ___.
At the moment, I'm working as a/an ___ at ___.
I'd like to do a master's degree in ___ because ___.
In my free time, I enjoy ___.
speaking.frame: Ý chính → because… → For example… · 2–4 câu mỗi lượt. Không hiểu câu hỏi thì hỏi lại bằng tiếng Anh.
rescue: Sorry, could you repeat the question, please?
That's a good question. Let me think…
I'm not sure, but I think…

questions.hint: Số người, ai làm gì, bạn thân nhất với ai và vì sao.
Ở đâu, nổi tiếng về gì, đã thay đổi thế nào (it has changed…, new roads have been built).
Học gì, làm gì; I have worked there for…; khó nhất là + V-ing.
1 sở thích, vì sao thích, lần gần nhất làm (quá khứ đơn).
I'm going to… / I hope to… after I finish my master's degree.
Dùng điện thoại / máy tính làm gì trong công việc; lợi và hại.
Vấn đề ở thành phố (traffic, air pollution, plastic); bạn làm gì để giúp.
Học bao lâu, khó nhất là gì, lợi ích cho công việc và học thạc sĩ.

rubric: Nội dung có lý do và ví dụ

reviewQuiz.q: She ___ in Hue when she was a child.
reviewQuiz.explain: when she was a child → quá khứ đơn.
since → have + V3, chủ động không có been.

reviewQuiz.q: Hoi An, ___ is famous for its old town, attracts many tourists.
reviewQuiz.explain: Sau là động từ is → which; có dấu phẩy → không that.

reviewQuiz.q: If I ___ you, I would take the job.
He asked me whether I ___ to the party the night before.
It took me two hours ___ the report.
The flight was cancelled ___ the storm.
reviewQuiz.explain: Sau là danh từ, chỉ nguyên nhân → because of.

reviewQuiz.q: She has ___ interesting job that she never wants to leave.
I wish I ___ more time to prepare for the exam last week.
reviewQuiz.explain: last week → tiếc quá khứ → had had.
